strategy.title: Test-sell the bond court-date/forfeiture tracker at $350, then sell to the licensed-agent list
strategy.why: Buyer, channel (410 licensed agencies), demand, conversion (18 paid of 300), Brain fulfilment ($5 cost, $0 exposure) and 3-day settlement are evidenced; the only unestablished link is the price: $350 is only what the owner says, with no invoice or published price. alternatives.why: Rejected: the price is measurable by a zero-cost live offer inside the window, which is faster than desk research and spends nothing.

openings.title: Court-date and forfeiture-deadline tracker for bail bond agencies

card.reachableChannel: Phone and email from the state insurance department's licensed bail agent list
card.offerScope: A tracker of every open bond's court dates and forfeiture deadlines, built by Brain from the agency's bond register; paid by card on delivery.

price 350 USD is a guess (ASSUMPTION), not something buyers are shown to pay
measured on this offer's own sales: 18 accepted of 300 contacts
9 deal(s) needed, 410 available in the window (410 reachable buyers are stated and no repeat purchase is, so one purchase each)

facts.value: The state insurance department lists 410 licensed bail bond agencies with addresses, phones and emails; each tracks forfeiture deadlines on every open bond.
Sell A tracker of every open bond's court dates and forfeiture deadlines, built by Brain from the agency's bond register; paid by card on delivery. to each buyer.
The owner says bail agents will pay $350 for it; no invoice or published price shows what any agency paid.

reviews.reasons: CONDITIONAL is the right stance. The only unestablished link is OFFER_AND_PRICE: the $350 price is the owner's word (PERSON), with no invoice or published price, and the 18/300 conversion did not record the price paid. A published benchmark of what other sellers charge would not establish what these agencies pay, so a zero-cost live offer at $350 is the measurement that decides it, and the plan names it (validation.decides = OFFER_AND_PRICE). Other links are EVIDENCE on the card: 410 licensed agencies reachable by phone/email, demand verified 2026-11-25, Brain-produced spreadsheet (PRODUCE_SPREADSHEET proved), $5 direct cost below price, $0 exposure, 3-day settlement. The test takes payment on delivery, after Brain builds the tracker, so it takes no orders that cannot be fulfilled. Recomputed at the pass threshold: 3/100 = 3% at $350; 3 test sales + 310 x 3% = 9.3, so about 12 sales x $350 = about $4,200, against the 8 sales ($2,800) the $2,500 target needs. Passing at the threshold therefore carries the target. Timing: test days 1-7, sell from day 8, delivery day 9, settlement around day 12, with slack before day 30 for late replies.
findings: Price is PERSON-only ($350 the owner says); correctly treated as UNKNOWN and made the decisive test link.
Threshold check: at exactly 3% conversion at $350 over 410 agencies, about 12 sales and about $4,300 gross, at least the 8 sales needed for $2,500. At the evidenced 6%, about 24 sales.
The 18/300 conversion has no recorded price, so conversion at $350 is also measured by the test, not known in advance. The plan's threshold measures it directly, which covers this.
The ledger books 9 receipts on day 9 but does not count the test-phase sales separately. Test sales are real revenue and add to the total, so this is a presentation gap, not a shortfall.
SEND_A_MESSAGE and ISSUE_AN_INVOICE show NOT_CONNECTED. Both must be connected before day 1 or the test window slips.
Card humanHours 0.5 per deal against the plan's ownerHours null. The goal sets no hours limit, so this does not bind, but phone outreach that needs a person should be stated.
